Welcome to 112 Castleland Court, Balbriggan, a superb three-bedroom duplex apartment presented in truly showhouse condition throughout.
This attractive own-door home is accessed via an external staircase, offering both privacy and a sense of independence rarely found in apartment living.

Ideally positioned at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac within this much sought-after residential development, the property enjoys a pleasant outlook over an open green area to the front, creating a bright and tranquil setting. Inside, the apartment boasts wonderful living space with spacious and well-proportioned accommodation designed for comfortable modern living. The light-filled living and dining area provides an inviting space to relax or entertain, while the balcony off the dining area is perfectly positioned to catch both the morning and afternoon sun.

The property offers three excellent-sized bedrooms, each thoughtfully laid out to maximise comfort and functionality. Additional benefits include gas-fired central heating, double-glazed windows for energy efficiency, and ample car parking available directly to the front of the apartment.

Combining generous living space, a prime cul-de-sac location, and an attractive outlook, No. 112 Castleland Court represents an ideal opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or those seeking a stylish and well-maintained home in a convenient Balbriggan setting. Early viewing is highly recommended.
